title: 未寄出的星光
description: 172 BPM 的 BCEG 主题逐段延伸、攀升，经过留白后以变化再现走向高潮

conventions.pitch: Scientific pitch notation; C4 = MIDI 60; B means B natural.
conventions.time: Absolute seconds from track start, rounded to six decimals.
conventions.gain: Linear amplitude multiplier, not MIDI velocity; rounded to nine decimals.
conventions.duration: Score gate duration; sample ringing, crossfade and reverb tails may continue afterwards.
conventions.parts: Grouped by instrument, potentially polyphonic; chronological note IDs preserve original event order.

primary_motif.development: Four-note seed at structural anchors; distinct continuation, bridge extension, varied return and new culmination. No repeated full eight-bar lead.

featured_strings.role: Culmination melody one octave lower; harp lead rests.
